init parameter defaults are evaluated per construction by the existing callee-side prologue, including defaults that reference earlier parameters, and construction arguments are aligned to the init declaration (positional then named, omitted defaulted parameters left to the prologue)
fixed fields may receive their value during construction (including from init) and become immutable only after the instance is published (StructInstance::under_construction + the SealStruct opcode)

invariant() is lowered to a <Type>.invariant(self) -> Bool predicate whose lines are combined with `and`, and is verified at the end of construction; a violated invariant is a contract runtime fault (VmFault::InvariantViolation), which follows the MVP error model

Bytes has the canonical construction form Bytes(count: Int) producing a zero-filled mutable block, with byte indexing yielding Byte, len, slicing, and a recoverable Failure outside the provisional allocation cap
